mapper.insert: insert into agent ( org_id, agent_code, agent_name, description, status, current_published_version_id, created_by, updated_by, created_at, updated_at ) values ( #{orgId}, #{agentCode}, #{agentName}, #{description}, #{status}, #{currentPublishedVersionId}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.select: select id, org_id, agent_code, agent_name, description, status, current_published_version_id, created_by, updated_by, created_at, updated_at from agent where org_id = #{orgId} and agent_code = #{agentCode} limit 1
